name: Take Your Chill Pills
source:
Life hasn't always been easy for Kale. Years of mental illness and anxiety have plagued him. If that wasn't bad enough, he's been having nightmares. Horrendous nightmares. Deep, dark, and brutal. What could they possibly mean? Finding out the truth may be harder than he thinks. Especially when he's fighting his greatest enemy yet... himself.

While a horrible dream can be woken from, a nightmare that's about to happen in the real world will change Kale's life forever.

Don't forget to take your chill pills.

[From [url=https://icebrrgdragon.itch.io/take-your-chill-pills]Itch.io[/url]]
